cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Ask the director why the overtime rule changed. I'll support you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Your fresh perspective won't carry my disciplinary history.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand beside me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just behind. Where supportive people remain employable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just behind. Where supportive people remain employable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule at tonight's club meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask him to restore your booking as well. I'll draft both requests for your speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then sign it. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.text: I'll leave space for my signature. Once he's agreed you have a point, call me up to add it.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm introducing everyone by first name. Even the owner.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner's doing the welcome. You offered to serve burgers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce the burger service: 'Director Patel will serve you.' I'd like them to hear who's making this gesture.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your location, Morgan's budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call it a compromise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your location, Morgan's budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call it a compromise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you wear my ribbon or Nina's for the chess club election?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Neither. You're both my friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep us both as friends. Which one do you want as chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's the vote. Tell me which ribbon you'll wear then; I'll happily lend you the other one today.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Bring that empty box to my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave your desk and stand by that open window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.
